_relics: 宝物: kept for one run (a chapter attempt). rarity: common / rare / legend 传说 (rarest: the AP ones) / curse (strong with a cost) / story. mods: at, magic, heal, hp, guard (damage taken cut), combo (extra per combo step), desperate (attack when below half HP), ap_start, ap_round, ap_max, turns, start_heal, boost_start, stun_start (chance the enemy loses round 1), stun_round (each round: chance the enemy is stunned and loses that turn), calm, no_ambush, chest, offer_extra, pierce (ignore resists), first_hit (first hit each battle), defend (extra defend cut), stun (confuse chance), troop_at / troop_hp {troop: share} (Rance X faction items), troop_cost {troop: AP off each skill, min 1}; after_win: heal this share of HP after every win; proc {troop: share} (每个兵种自带 15% 的自动小技能：后勤回血、刀兵举盾、枪兵反击、贼 BOOST、策士战意、弓兵降敌双抗——宝物在这个几率上加), resist_cut (弓兵: the enemy's 兵刃抗性 and 谋略抗性 each lowered by this, for good), raid (骑兵: more 插入 突袭 chance, 骑兵自带 30%) — base chances: battle.json passive_chance / interrupt_by_troop — all automatic, no AP; 每个兵种的宝物各有特点：后勤回复、刀兵防御、枪兵反击、骑兵突袭、贼 BOOST、策士攻防、弓兵破抗
_fates: 天命: every run of a chapter starts by picking one of fate_offer fates; its mods (same keys as relics) last the run. common = 吉, rare = 大吉, curse = double-edged, bad = 凶 (pure drawback), divine = 天授 (far stronger than the rest) — neither is offered at the start, only a ？ event's `fate` hands them out
